definitions.explanation: Counts the number of days. Used after a number to indicate a duration in days.
Indicates the day of the month when used after a number. Days 1 through 10 and the 20th have special native Japanese readings.

examples.japanese: {旅行|りょこう}は{五|いつ}{日間|かかん}だった。
examples.english: The trip was five days long.
examples.notes: 〜{日間|にちかん} is used for duration: 'for ~ days.'

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{十五|じゅうご}{日|にち}だ。
{誕生日|たんじょうび}は{何|なん}{日|にち}ですか。
{給料|きゅうりょう}は{毎月|まいつき}{二十五|にじゅうご}{日|にち}に{振|ふ}り{込|こ}まれる。
examples.english: Salary is deposited on the 25th of every month.
